questions.label: Business Description
questions.text: Let's start with your business. In a sentence or two, what makes Biz special to couples getting married?
questions.placeholder: e.g. We've been in the wedding industry for 8 years...

questions.label: Services / Packages
questions.text: What services or packages would you like to list on your website? Add each one, and the price if you'd like to show it.

questions.label: Service Areas & Booking
questions.text: Which towns or cities do you serve? And how do couples usually get in touch to book you — Messenger, phone call, or something else?

questions.label: Photos, Logo & Colors
questions.text: Do you have a logo, photos of your work, or favorite colors you'd like us to use? This is optional — skip it if you don't have anything ready yet.
questions.placeholder: Favorite colors, e.g. Blush pink and gold

questions.label: Website Style
questions.text: What kind of look would you like for your website? This is just a preference — our design team creates the final look for you.

questions.label: Additional Info
questions.text: Anything else couples should know? For example reviews, ongoing promos, or how far in advance they should book. This is optional.
questions.placeholder: Optional — leave blank to skip

questions.label: Guest Capacity
questions.text: About how many guests can your venue fit comfortably?
questions.placeholder: e.g. 150 guests

questions.label: What's Included
questions.text: Besides the venue space, what else is included — like catering, tables and chairs, or decorations?

services.*.name: required
string
max:120
extra2: in:"Venue space only","Venue + basic setup (tables & chairs)","Venue + full package (catering, decor, etc.)","It depends on the package"
